about: Inputs of the filter studies. Every downloaded file is listed, with its size and SHA-256, in the manifest that the study's fetch script wrote at download time; this index names those manifests, the folders the files are replayed into, and, for the tables that came through the Hugging Face rows API, the parquet file each is rebuilt from and its normalized content hash. Written before any replay, from the archived copies. replay_inputs.py states the rules. inputs.json, the inputs of the WN18RR study and of the scope cards, is unchanged.

run_json.check: the rule gives 281 run.json files; each agrees with the archived file in every field it writes (281 archived run.json files in all)
